babs.2: Do not swear by your fathers
babs.3: One does not swear by al-Lat and al-'Uzza nor by the taghut
babs.4: Whoever swore on something even though he was not asked to swear
babs.5: Whoever swore by a religion other than Islam
babs.6: One should not say: "What Allah wills and you will"
babs.7: The saying of Allah, the Exalted: "And they swore by Allah their strongest oaths"
babs.8: If he says: "I bear witness by Allah" or "I have borne witness by Allah"
babs.9: The covenant of Allah, the Mighty and Majestic
babs.10: Swearing by the might of Allah, His attributes and His words
babs.11: A man's saying: "By the life of Allah"
babs.12: "Allah does not take you to account for what is unintentional in your oaths …"
babs.14: The saying of Allah, the Exalted: "Indeed, those who exchange the covenant of Allah and their oaths for a small price …"
babs.15: Oaths regarding what one does not own, in disobedience and in anger
babs.16: If he says: "By Allah, I will not speak today", then prays, recites, says tasbih or takbir
babs.17: Whoever swore not to go to his wives for a month
babs.18: If he swore not to drink nabidh and then drank
babs.19: If he swore not to eat condiment and then ate dates with bread
babs.21: If he gives away his wealth as a vow and repentance
babs.22: If he forbids himself his food
babs.23: Fulfilling vows and His saying: "They fulfil their vows"
babs.24: The sin of one who does not fulfil his vow
babs.26: If he vowed or swore in the Jahiliyya not to speak to someone, then embraced Islam
babs.28: Vows regarding what one does not own and in disobedience
babs.29: Whoever vowed to fast days which coincided with the day of sacrifice or of breaking the fast
babs.30: Do land, sheep, crops and goods fall under oaths and vows?
